Column one begins here. Browsers lay out multi-column text by filling
the first column to its height before flowing into the second, so a reader
must finish the left column before the right one begins. Extraction that
sorts purely by baseline interleaves the two.
Column two continues the argument. Justified text stretches inter-word
spacing, which a gap-based word splitter must tolerate without
inventing or losing spaces between words.
